stepBody: Sam uses the following model to predict $$attendance_{rate}$$:\n$$\hat{\text{attendance\_rate}} $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 $$\times$$ (\text{dist\_from\_bell}) + \hat{\theta}_2 $$\times$$ (\text{section\_no})$$\nHe trains three versions of this model: one without regularization, one with L1 regularization, and one with L2 regularization. He finds different optimal parameters from each version of training: $${\theta_{vec}}^a$$ $$=$$ [0, $$0.1$$, 0], $${\theta_{vec}}^b$$ $$=$$ [1, $$0.5$$, 2], $${\theta_{vec}}^c$$ $$=$$ $$[0.05$$, $$0.08$$, $$0.03]$$.
